agentDesc: Hands-free AI copilot for Rokid Glasses monochrome-green HUD. Voice Q&A uses the Rokid on-device assistant LLM (Metis), temple-tap scene analysis sends a camera photo to a Google Cloud (Vertex AI Gemini) proxy, and the dashboard shows IMU telemetry.
agentPrompt: Hello! I am your Vision & Voice Copilot. Tap the temple or speak a wake word to ask a question or analyze the scene ahead.
